name: Cheesy Turkey and Black Bean Taco Skillet
ingredients_verbatim: 15 oz. black beans, drained and rinsed
Fresh Cilantro, roughly chopped, for garnish
why: Ground turkey stovetop taco filling (browned turkey simmered with broth, taco seasoning, black beans, tomato, onion, then finished with shredded cheese + sour cream) served in romaine leaves. Published nutrition 521 cal / 48g protein / 32g carbs clears the 400-650 band and stays under the 35g carb ceiling. Every ingredient maps to the board (ground-turkey, chicken-broth, taco-seasoning, canned-black-beans, tomatoes, red-onion, sour-cream, shredded-cheese, lettuce, cilantro). Cheese + sour cream are the calorie drivers that lift it above the 400 floor where plain turkey-veg skillets (~230 cal) fall short. Scales cleanly to 14 via weigh-and-divide of the skillet filling.
confidence: verified from source page nutrition; two caveats: (1) 32g carbs sits near the ceiling and our label-accurate recompute could nudge it over 35 (black beans are the carb driver); (2) DEDUP RISK - concept overlaps low-carb-turkey-taco-skillet and ground-turkey-taco-stuffed-peppers, but this version is differentiated by black beans + cheese/sour-cream finish and the lettuce-wrap format. Selector should weigh both.
